WITH sl AS (
  SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2)
SELECT 'sales_lines' k, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d2, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, sum(net_amount) amt FROM sl
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_all', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), sum(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_of_P2', count(*), count(DISTINCT return_line_id), count(DISTINCT sales_line_id), min(return_date), max(return_date), sum(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line WHERE sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM sl)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_orphan', count(*), 0, 0, min(return_date), max(return_date), sum(refund_net) FROM fact_return_line WHERE sales_line_id NOT IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'formats:'||format||'/'||CAST(store_id>=900 AS VARCHAR), count(*), count(DISTINCT store_id), 0, NULL, NULL, 0 FROM dim_store GROUP BY format, store_id>=900

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, s.format AS fmt_then, cs.format AS fmt_now, s.store_id, p.category
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT l.fmt_then, l.fmt_now, (l.store_id=999) AS is999, (l.category='ZZ Test') AS test,
       count(*) n, SUM(l.net_amount) sold_net, COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0) returned_net,
       ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(l.net_amount),3) rate
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT w.status, count(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) sold_net, SUM(r.refund_net) refunds, count(r.sales_line_id) lines_returned
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key AND s.store_id=900
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) rn, SUM(quantity_returned) rq FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'over_returned_lines' k, count(*) n, COALESCE(SUM(r.rn - f.net_amount),0) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date JOIN r USING (sales_line_id)
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND (r.rn > f.net_amount + 0.01 OR r.rq > f.quantity)
UNION ALL

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, s.format
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY CASE l.format WHEN 'Large' THEN 1 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Small' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
